authorization_boundary.required_before_any_source_model_or_eval: Separate independent review of this complete-economics design and explicit owner GO.
authorization_boundary.basis: P2 cold-restore metadata records P3_authorized=false and promotion_permission=false.

purpose: Bound one paired B/C opening-action experiment to test whether fixed signed path-area information changes costed economic outcomes after matched controls. P2 bridge completion, local labels, or fit readiness do not themselves establish predictive or economic value.
hypothesis: Within the frozen 09:46 opening EXECUTE/HOLD receiver, adding signed SOXX/SOXL prefix path area may improve costed outcomes over the matched neutral-area model after identical original22 inputs, eight path controls, and mask.

p2_metadata_basis.count_limit: These strict-maturity totals are not the final exact fit-eligible feature/guard/class counts. Verify those counts in a bounded, separately authorized preflight; do not infer fit eligibility from 243.

B.features: Original22 + eight fixed path controls + shared prefix mask + area slot fixed at zero (32 inputs total).

C.features: Same 32-input pipeline and rows as B; only the final area slot is observed signed A.

model_design.pipeline: Preserve SimpleImputer(strategy=mean), StandardScaler, LogisticRegression(C=0.10,class_weight=balanced,max_iter=2000,random_state=42), threshold=0.50 and original mandatory guards. Fit preprocessing on training rows only.
model_design.target: EXECUTE iff local Delta > 0; ties and nonpositive labels are HOLD. No abs(Delta) weighting, A-by-direction interactions, extra heads, feature selection, threshold/seed/window tuning, or model-family search.
model_design.cutoff: Both final fits may use only labels strictly mature before 2023-01-01 00:00 America/New_York. No 2022 development refits hidden in the budget.
model_design.minimum_rows: At least 200 eligible mature rows for each actual fit, plus retain/report the original pre-2022 support gate without lowering it. If a gate fails, stop or mark needs_data; do not manufacture support.
model_design.bounded_preflight: Before fitting, verify and record exact final pre-2023 rows by eligibility and class using the pinned labels/features/guards, and the pre-2022 support count. Existing 243 and class totals are context only, not a substitute.

model_barrier: Seal both fitted model files, preprocessing objects, feature order, training cutoffs, row/class counts, code identity and hashes before any 2023+ price, prediction, label, or evaluation-account object is read. No screening result may cancel any of the six preregistered accounts.

evaluation.account_state: Each family/cost path has independent quantities, cash, receivables, fee counters, NAV, peak and risk state. Preserve the frozen raw execution, corporate-action, target/reset, missing-session and terminal-row contracts; no synthetic fills.
evaluation.commission: Frozen IBKR Pro Tiered schedule and existing account cost conventions.

references.SOXX: Final hard gate at each matching cost.
references.strong references: Exact pre-approved books only when price grid, corporate-action, tariff and initial-state identities match; diagnostic attribution only.

evaluation.reuse_boundary: Repeated historical use, OOF construction, a new card, or an independent reviewer does not make reused dates independent validation.

hard_gates_v2.benchmark: SOXX only; pair each strategy cost path with same-window, same-accounting-basis SOXX.
hard_gates_v2.net_wealth: Fee-adjusted relative wealth ratio versus SOXX > 1 at all three costs, using frozen numeric tolerance.
hard_gates_v2.risk: Close and available raw-point maximum drawdown <=30%; CVaR5 no worse than SOXX. If complete minute-risk evidence is unavailable, state the qualification gap.
hard_gates_v2.annual: At least two complete years; positive SOXX excess in >=70% of complete years. Incomplete years separate.
hard_gates_v2.rolling: Positive SOXX excess in >=70% of all eligible overlapping 126-trading-day windows; retain every window.

statistics.pairs: Three SOXX cost comparisons are the statistical hard gate.
statistics.method: Paired mean daily log excess; stationary bootstrap; mean block length 63; 10,000 resamples; seed 20261014.
statistics.alpha_note: Retain conservative frozen family allocation .025/15 even though SOXX alone is the v2 hard-gate family; no outcome-dependent change.

hard_gates_v2.independent_forward: Historical success only makes a future forward candidate. Independent forward evidence is a separate requirement and is not established by this P3 historical design.

diagnostic_attribution.failure_readback: For a failed gate, perform one bounded attribution across every complete annual interval and every 126-day window, then the decision chain: source and availability -> prediction -> target -> risk projection/mandatory guard -> execute or hold -> holdings/holding duration -> fees -> NAV.
diagnostic_attribution.reporting: Keep all annual and rolling windows, including losing and overlapping windows. Separate target changes, action changes, execution/cost effects and account outcomes. Do not add local label advantages into portfolio return or select windows after observing outcomes.

stop_and_exit_rules: If source identities, timing, maturity, row/class support, or frozen label definitions fail preflight, stop with needs_data or blocked-by-design as applicable; do not reduce minimum rows or alter features.

If any final SOXX hard gate fails, mark this fixed version not_promoted, retain minimum auditable evidence and perform one necessary attribution. No threshold, sign, window, seed, model, or cost rescue on reused history.
If implementation or native account reconciliation fails, preserve actual completion and failure evidence; no automatic retry or budget reset. A repair requires explicit scope and authorization.
Passing historical gates does not establish independent forward qualification or production permission.
draft_disclaimer: This file is a design draft only. It does not modify the frozen plan, authorize implementation or reads, constitute fresh independent validation, or claim scientific success.
